title: AetherMind engine bundle provenance manifest
tree_root_resolution: The engine tree root is the directory that holds the lib/ and mcp/ folders on the host that serves the AetherMind MCP service. Resolve that directory on that host before verifying. This file names no host-specific path or address.
verify: On the serving host: cd <engine_tree_root> && for f in $(jq -r '.files | keys[]' <manifest>); do echo "$(jq -r --arg f "$f" '.files[$f]' <manifest>)  $f"; done | sha256sum -c
Query the live MCP server's capabilities: implementation_sha256 must equal this manifest's files entry for lib/aethermind/core.py.
